notes.title: Game Update -Blooming Spring!- Ver.1.0.7 - March 25
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Macholium.
We’re excited to bring you a new update to enhance your gaming experience! Here are the patch details:

◆ Seasonal Items Added
New spring-themed objects have been added to the Seasonal category in the shop.
Enjoy a lineup perfect for hanami, featuring cherry blossoms, bamboo, and a traditional tea set for outdoor gatherings with your macho companions.
Experience the breathtaking contrast of delicate cherry blossoms and powerful muscles in full bloom!

Thank you for your continued support of Macholium -Muscle Aquarium Simulator- .

notes.title: Game Update -Winter Holiday!- Ver.1.0.6 - December 19
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Macholium.
We are excited to announce a new update to enhance your gaming experience. Below are the details of the update patch:

◆ Seasonal Items Added
Winter-themed objects have been added to the Seasonal category in the shop.
Celebrate Christmas or the New Year with traditional Japanese items, making your winter holidays cozy and festive in Macholium!
◆ Object Rotation Customization
Previously, object rotation was based on the camera. Now, by enabling "World Axis Rotation" in the settings, you can rotate objects independently of the camera’s orientation.
This feature is perfect for those who want to adjust object placement while viewing the aquarium from various angles.
Thank you for your continued support of Macholium -Muscle Aquarium Simulator-.

notes.title: Game Update Ver1.0.1 - May 31
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Machorium. We have made some fixes and improvements to make your gaming experience more enjoyable. Here are the details of the update patch:

◆ Bugs
・Fixed an issue where objects could not be selected if the UI was turned off due to time passing while changing a macho's name.

◆ UI Improvements
・Changed the cursor in certain modes.
・In the shop, items that can be placed now glow when moused over.
・Added a note to the layout save screen indicating that game progress is auto-saved. 
　([b]The save function only includes the layout information of the tank, including the placed machos.[/b])

◆ Tutorial Text Additions
・Added messages about basic operations when placing objects.
　　[b]Rotation: WASD　 
　　Up/Down: FG 　
　　Size: ER
　　View Rotation: Middle Drag[/b]

We appreciate your continued support of "Machorium -Muscle Aquarium Simulator-".
